session_1.speaker: Alice
session_1.text: I moved to Seattle last week for my new job at Contoso.

session_1.speaker: Bob
session_1.text: Congrats! How do you like the city so far?

session_1.speaker: Alice
session_1.text: I love the rain here, and I adopted a cat named Mochi.

session_2.speaker: Alice
session_2.text: I started training for the Seattle marathon every morning.

session_2.speaker: Bob
session_2.text: Nice. I finally finished reading that novel you gave me.

session_2.speaker: Alice
session_2.text: Mochi broke my favorite mug yesterday, I was so upset.

session_3.speaker: Alice
session_3.text: I moved again, now I live in Portland and work remotely.

session_3.speaker: Bob
session_3.text: So no more Seattle marathon training?

session_3.speaker: Alice
session_3.text: Right, these days I go swimming instead of running.
